testMatrixBase.purpose: Restore protected R51 runtime contract on current focus while retaining provenance diagnostics and binary/source-binding guards.

slots.hypothesis: Protected R51-equivalent DX9Ex runtime behavior is preserved on the current project tree.
slots.expectedObservable: Road/background/vehicle stereo and startup/gameplay remain at R51 level; existing HUD defects may remain.
slots.note: Exact candidate package extracted and verified from GitHub Actions artifact 10811237291; dinput8.dll/config/profile-library identities are frozen.

slots.hypothesis: Exact producer/node semantic ownership must be available at the relevant VS/c64 boundary; failed 8d21824f candidate must not be recreated unchanged.
slots.expectedObservable: Exact SCREEN_HUD perspective draws are no longer vetoed by a pre-draw c64 world verification; HUD diplopia/head-lock should improve while protected world stereo remains unchanged.

slots.hypothesis: Lens flare is a dedicated transformed 3D alpha camera-effect path and must be traced/scoped at its exact producer.

slots.note: EXE HUD inspector and exact-SHA DX9Ex Active Validation both passed; producer telemetry only.

slots.hypothesis: Dense-scene loss must be localized to draw amplification/copies/waits/resource churn/frame cadence and optimized independently of HUD completion.
slots.expectedObservable: 5-second telemetry reports DirectGPU producer-fence sample count, poll count, average wait us and maximum wait us alongside fallback/backpressure counters; stereo behavior is unchanged.
slots.note: Exact-SHA DX9Ex Active Validation passed; instrumentation only, no fence/synchronization policy change.

nonBlockingRule: HUD/FLARE work may continue, but it must never block PERFORMANCE, DXVK or DX12 implementation/build/test preparation.
testOrderNote: Order is for efficient user testing only, not a dependency chain. Backend/performance development continues even if HUD/FLARE remains unresolved.
